item-type.name: Level of description
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.4: level of the unit of description

item-type.name: Reference code
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.1: reference code of the unit, unique in the fonds

item-type.name: Other identifier
item-type.description: Former reference code, accession number or another identifier; the specification says which

item-type.name: Title
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.2: title of the unit of description, formal or supplied

item-type.name: Date(s) of creation
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.3: date or range of dates of creation of the unit

item-type.name: Bulk dates
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.3: dates of the bulk of the unit when they differ from the dates of creation

item-type.name: Date(s) as text
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.3: the dates in words when the structured date cannot express them

item-type.name: Extent and medium
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.5: extent and medium of the unit as it is stated in the finding aid, e.g. "128 boxes (12.5 linear metres)"

item-type.name: Quantity
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.5: measured extent; the specification is the unit of measure

item-type.name: Material type
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.1.5: form of the material (textual records, maps, photographs, ...)

item-type.name: Dimensions
item-type.description: Dimensions of the item, e.g. "62 x 48 cm"

item-type.name: Scale
item-type.description: Scale of a map, plan or technical drawing, e.g. "1:2880"

item-type.name: Duration (minutes)
item-type.description: Duration of a sound recording or moving images in minutes

item-type.name: Creator
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.2.1: the person, family or corporate body that created or accumulated the unit

item-type.name: Administrative / biographical history
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.2.2: history of the creator, when it is not kept with the entity

item-type.name: Archival history
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.2.3: history of the custody of the unit

item-type.name: Immediate source of acquisition or transfer
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.2.4: source from which the unit was acquired, with date and method

item-type.name: Scope and content
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.3.1: scope, content and form of the unit

item-type.name: Appraisal, destruction and scheduling
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.3.2: appraisal and destruction actions and their basis

item-type.name: Accruals
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.3.3: expected additions to the unit

item-type.name: System of arrangement
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.3.4: internal structure, order and classification of the unit

item-type.name: Conditions governing access
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.4.1: legal and other conditions restricting or affecting access

item-type.name: Access status
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.4.1: whether the unit is open, restricted or closed

item-type.name: Open from
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.4.1: date from which a restricted or closed unit becomes open

item-type.name: Conditions governing reproduction
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.4.2: restrictions on reproduction and copyright

item-type.name: Language of material
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.4.3: language of the material

item-type.name: Script of material
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.4.3: script or notation system of the material

item-type.name: Physical characteristics and technical requirements
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.4.4: physical condition and equipment needed to use the unit

item-type.name: Finding aids
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.4.5: finding aids that exist for the unit

item-type.name: Existence and location of originals
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.5.1: where the originals are when the unit consists of copies

item-type.name: Existence and location of copies
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.5.2: copies of the unit and where they are

item-type.name: Related units of description
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.5.3: related units in the same or another repository

item-type.name: Link to related material
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.5.3: link to a related unit or resource

item-type.name: Publication note
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.5.4: publications about or based on the unit

item-type.name: Note
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.6.1: information that fits no other element

item-type.name: Internal note
item-type.description: Note for the archivists, not published

item-type.name: Archivist's note
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.7.1: how the description was prepared and by whom

item-type.name: Archivist
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.7.1: the person who prepared the description

item-type.name: Rules or conventions
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.7.2: rules and conventions the description follows

item-type.name: Date(s) of descriptions
item-type.description: ISAD(G) 3.7.3: when the description was prepared or revised

item-type.name: Container
item-type.description: Storage unit holding the unit: box, folder, volume ... with its number

item-type.name: Kind of container
item-type.description: Kind of the storage unit

item-type.name: Container prefix
item-type.description: Text before the number of the container

item-type.name: Container number
item-type.description: Number of the container

item-type.name: Container postfix
item-type.description: Text after the number of the container

item-type.name: Location
item-type.description: Where the container is kept (depot, row, shelf)

item-type.name: Digital object
item-type.description: Link to a digital copy or a born-digital object of the unit

item-type.name: Access point
item-type.description: Entity the unit is indexed by; the specification is its role (subject, place, author, ...)

item-type.name: Title of the finding aid
item-type.description: Title printed on the finding aid

item-type.name: Kind of finding aid
item-type.description: Inventory, catalogue, guide or list

item-type.name: Compiled by
item-type.description: Who compiled the finding aid

item-type.name: Date of the finding aid
item-type.description: When the finding aid was completed

item-type.name: Language of the finding aid
item-type.description: Language the finding aid is written in

item-type.name: Note to the finding aid
item-type.description: Introduction or note printed in the finding aid

item-type.name: Attachment
item-type.description: File attached to the finding aid
